7. Investment in Chipewyan Prairie Business Trust
The Investment in government business enterprises - Chipewyan Prairie Business Trust consists of
Chipewyan Prairie Business Trust's investment in Janvier Pipeline Services Limited Partnership (99.90%),
Janvier Land Site Services Limited Partnership (99.90%), Chipewyan Prairie Real Estate Development
Limited Partnership (99.00%), TDN Contracting Ltd. (100%), TDN Contracting Limited Partnership
(99.99%), Chipewyan Prairie Industry Relations Limited Partnership (99.99%) and Sekui Limited
Partnership (51%), plus any contributions made by the First Nation to the limited partnership less any
distributions paid by the limited partnerships to the Trust, less the cash distributions paid by the limited
partnerships to the Trust.
Janvier Pipeline Services Limited Partnership was dissolved June 28, 2022.
As described in note 1(a), investment in government business enterprises are recorded using the modified
equity basis.
Change in investments in government business enterprises
The Trust also holds investments in Chipewyan Prairie Store Limited Partnership (99.00%), Prairie Dene
Development Limited Partnership (99.90%), and Janvier Laundry Facility Limited Partnership (99.99%).
During the year it was determined that these entities no longer met the definition of a government
business enterprise and therefore these entities are accounted for as governmental units. As this change
occurred during the March 31, 2023 fiscal year, the prior year balances were not adjusted for the change
in status. As a result, the opening investment in business enterprises increased by $181,789 which was
the net deficit amount of these business enterprises as at April 1, 2022. These changes have been made
on a prospective basis.
